name: Agent Persona
description: A form for giving an agent a face, a name and a voice, with a water-droplet character whose eyes follow the pointer.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting configuration: name, role, description, language, notifications, mood and color. Missing fields fall back to an unnamed calm water agent with the first role and language.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the whole configuration whenever any part of it changes.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the card. Other props go to the root section element.

props.name: mood
props.description: Shapes the eyes and mouth. Changing it morphs the face from one mood to the next.

props.name: color
props.description: A palette colour by name, or any CSS colour. A new colour fills the drop from the bottom.

props.name: followPointer
props.description: Turns the face toward the pointer anywhere on the page.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Without it the avatar is hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the svg. Other props go to the svg element.
